plan.scope: Retained English plain-text articles from the earlier multi-paragraph trial. Fit using the 12 earlier works and hold out the ten additional works. Add one new matched ordinary same-work substitution per original when exact segmentation and length agree.
plan.candidate: An interior native sentence with 12–65 words and adjacent sentences of 8–80 words. Native contexts may cross a paragraph break. Omit first and last sentences. Use the existing exact three-sentence input and read the isolated center and flanks and the left-right input with the center omitted.
plan.ordinary_splice: Take the closest-length eligible sentence from the disjoint genuine same-article excerpt already extracted for the MIME quote. Require 12–65 words, within half to twice target word length, distinct from every original sentence and complete sentence punctuation. Resolve ties by donor source order. Verify that only one native sentence changed.
plan.reference: First six exact native primary contexts scoring at least .50. Use each complete measured context for overlap, including if it crosses a paragraph break.
features: independent full three-sentence log odds minus its center-omitted log odds
isolated independent log odds above the stronger isolated neighbor
plan.fit: Standardize with fitting observations only, then fit balanced L2 logistic regression with C=1. Positive observations are exact known generated centers. Negative observations are all eligible centers in ordinary originals and the exact center of each ordinary substitution. Compare the three unfitted raw scores and the combined fit.
plan.point: Each arm selects its unique top focus and requires strict excess of the third-largest group maximum across fitting ordinary originals and ordinary substitutions. A group alerts if either ordinary file alerts.
plan.overlap: A useful result covers at least half the known edited nonwhitespace characters and has at least .30 intersection over union. Separate false ordinary groups, ordinary changed centers selected, wrong locations and unassessed.
plan.advance: Use the combined rule as a supplemental cue only if it adds two held useful locations in distinct work groups and across both generators, without more than one new ordinary work group. Require complete measured geometry on at least 12 of 14 known edits. Compare against the earlier held baseline and preserve its useful locations by union.
